Public token symbol string storage variable
Public token decimals storage variable
Public total token supply storage variable
Mapping of address to token balance; mutated in _transfer and constructor
Nested mapping of owner to spender to approved amount
Contract constructor initializing name, symbol, decimals, totalSupply and assigning entire supply to msg.sender
External transfer function moving tokens from msg.sender to _to
Internal helper performing balance mutations and emitting Transfer event
External function approving _spender to spend _value on behalf of msg.sender
External function transferring tokens from _from using the msg.sender allowance
Caller-controlled address used for balance ownership, allowance ownership and supply assignment

Addition balanceOf[_to] + _value in _transfer, potential arithmetic risk

Constructor parameter for initial total token supply

edges.reason: Constructor parameter _name flows into constructor execution and is assigned to name
Constructor parameter _symbol flows into constructor execution and is assigned to symbol
Constructor parameter _decimals flows into constructor execution and is assigned to decimals
Constructor parameter _totalSupply flows into constructor execution and is assigned to totalSupply and balanceOf
_totalSupply parameter value is written into totalSupply state variable
msg.sender determines the initial balance recipient in the constructor
Constructor writes the name state variable
Constructor writes the symbol state variable
Constructor writes the decimals state variable
Constructor writes the totalSupply state variable
Constructor writes balanceOf[msg.sender] with the total supply
Recipient parameter _to is used as an argument of transfer
Amount parameter _value is used in the transfer balance check and call
msg.sender is the implicit source of funds and checked via balanceOf in transfer
transfer reads balanceOf[msg.sender] for the require check
transfer internally invokes _transfer to perform the balance mutation
Named return local success is returned true by transfer
Source parameter _from is used in _transfer balance lookups and mutations
Recipient parameter _to is validated and credited in _transfer
Amount parameter _value is used in _transfer subtractions and additions
_transfer computes balanceOf[_from] - _value inside the unsafe subtraction operation
Result of balanceOf[_from] - _value is written back into balanceOf[_from]
_transfer computes balanceOf[_to] + _value inside the unsafe addition operation
Result of balanceOf[_to] + _value is written back into balanceOf[_to]
_transfer directly state-mutates the balanceOf mapping for both _from and _to
Spender parameter _spender is validated and stored by approve
Amount parameter _value is stored as the approved allowance in approve
msg.sender is the allowance owner whose approval is being set in approve
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] state variable
Source parameter _from is used in transferFrom balance and allowance checks
Recipient parameter _to is passed through transferFrom into _transfer
Amount parameter _value is checked and decremented in transferFrom
msg.sender determines whose allowance is consumed in transferFrom
transferFrom reads balanceOf[_from] for the require check
transferFrom reads and writes allowance[_from][msg.sender]
transferFrom computes allowance[_from][msg.sender] - _value in the unsafe subtraction operation
Result of the allowance subtraction is written back into the allowance mapping
transferFrom internally invokes _transfer after allowance checks
